scope: User-requested addition of the 52 recovered Gwanmesia modulus rows to the existing 95-channel conditional diagnostic. Not a full 220-channel fit or author-workflow reproduction.
model: Same source BM3 plus constant-theta Debye thermal pressure and operational EosFit KS conversion as the 95-channel diagnostic; V0=125.35 cm3/mol, Tr=298 K, n=20 fixed; R=float32(8.314). No new EOS law.
gwanmesia_conversion: Use all Table 1 rows in published order; T_K=T_C+273.15, including room-temperature T=303.15 K. Retain original NaCl/Decker pressures. Do not add the 52 excluded XRD volumes.
gwanmesia_coordinate_widths: For this conditional diagnostic assign sP=0.007*P and sKS=0.008*KS from the source-reported typical precision/error estimates. This treats global relative estimates as diagonal per-row weights; confidence level and covariance are not known. These are not recovered independent one-sigma errors or author-assigned weights. Numerical T errors are missing and omitted, not known zero. No tuning of these weights to publication parity.
objective: Keep the existing IRLS effective-variance pressure residuals, coordinate-error propagation, Milani quartz recalibration, ambient adoption, two freely fitted VT multipliers and Kono calculated-modulus multiplier. Add one freely fitted Gwanmesia calculated-modulus multiplier, matching the source's scale direction. Shared anchor/calibration and derived-modulus covariance remain omitted.
compute_cap: Two starts, at most 30 IRLS iterations and 400 least-squares function evaluations per iteration per start, unchanged solver tolerances. No further weight/model/selection search.
comparison: Retain the earlier 95-channel receipt unchanged. Report four EOS coefficients and two modulus scales against the unchanged source, absolute and percentage differences, and absolute-distance change from the earlier fit. Report dataset-wise pressure and native V/KS residuals for source and fitted coefficients on the identical 147 rows, using the fitted nuisance scales for both curves to isolate coefficient effects. Also show source-original modulus scales separately for Gwanmesia. Published widths are descriptive comparison scales, not a statistical significance test.
uncertainty: Report local inverse-Jacobian covariance without chi-square rescaling, conditional on the adopted diagonal weighting and nuisance scales. Report reduced objective with 139 nominal degrees of freedom; it is not the original source chi-square or a calibrated probability statement.
exclusions: Keep all earlier exclusions: no mixed-composition Isaak expansion as measured endmember volumes; no missing Isaak/Conrad errors invented; no digitization bounds used as experimental errors for Thieblot; no indexed-only Bosenick/Rodehorst expansion added. No catalog coefficient, record or classification changes.
stopping_rule: Record convergence and differences at this declared scope. No alternative models, weights or replacements to force agreement. Original masks, normalization, errors and author fit controls remain unresolved.
